resources.string: Profiles save your option configurations. You can save, save as, or delete profiles. The Default profile cannot be deleted. Unsaved changes to options will be lost on exit.
Recursive: Scans all subdirectories within the selected source folder.\nCurrent folder: Scans only the selected source folder, ignoring subdirectories.

Skip: Ignores the file if it already exists in the destination.
Overwrite: Replaces the existing file in the destination.
Rename: Appends a number to the file name (e.g. file(1).jpg).
Smart: Skips if the file size and date match, otherwise renames.
Extensions are separated by commas (e.g. jpg,mp4). It must be media files like video and photos.
Patterns can be separated by commas. Use * for wildcard (e.g. *holiday*).

Use "/" to create folders (e.g. {yyyy}/{MM}/{file_name}).

Available variables:
{yyyy} - Year (e.g., 2026)
{MM} - Month (01-12)
{dd} - Day (01-31)
{HH} - Hour (00-23)
{mm} - Minute (00-59)
{ss} - Second (00-59)
{file_name} - Full file name (e.g. abc.jpg)
{file_relative_path} - Relative folder path without file name (e.g. aaa/bbb)
{file_name_only} - File name without extension (e.g. abc)
{file_ext} - Original file extension (e.g. jpg)
